features: Dual Mode Connectivity: Switch easily between 2.4GHz wireless USB receiver and Bluetooth 5.0 for seamless multi-device control across PC, Android, and tablets.
Rechargeable 400mAh Battery: Convenient USB Type-C charging port removes the need for single-use batteries for eco-friendly power on the go.
Precision Optical Sensor: Features adjustable sensitivity up to 1600 DPI and high-precision optical tracking for smooth navigation on multiple surface types.
4-Button Functional Control: Includes Left Click, Right Click, Tactile Scroll Wheel Click, and a dedicated DPI adjustment switch for quick customization.
ERGONOMIC & SILENT: Comfortable ergonomic design with silent clicks reduces noise, and comes with a 1 Year Warranty.
description: Upgrade your setup with the Frontech MS-0077 Dual-Mode Wireless Mouse. Featuring both 2.4GHz USB and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, seamlessly toggle between laptops, PCs, tablets, and smart devices. Designed with a striking red honeycomb backlight, standard 4-button layout, and adjustable sensitivity up to 1600 DPI for precise optical tracking across multiple surfaces. Powered by a built-in 400mAh rechargeable battery, it recharges quickly using the included USB Type-C cable—eliminating disposable batteries. Compact, ultra-lightweight at just 50.2g, and ergonomically crafted for comfortable work, study, or everyday gaming sessions.
